about: Sentences for Fix the Sentence, written for this app at about a 2nd to 3rd grade reading level. Each sentence has exactly one wrong word: wrong is its position (counting from 0), fix is the right word, options are three choices including the fix, and why is the reason shown afterward. Characters are made up.
